notes: 1P2007 s.352(1)(a): minimum building setback from a rear property line is 1.5 m for any portion of the building used as a Backyard Suite.

condition: measured from grade at a side property line shared with a parcel designated with a low density residential district
notes: 1P2007 s.352(4.1)(a): conditional edge height; rises at 45 degrees to 7.5 m per (4.1)(c).

notes: 1P2007 s.352(5): maximum floor area of a Backyard Suite is 75.0 m2; relaxable by 10% per (6) — the base bound is the verifiable claim.

notes: 1P2007 s.539(8): laned-parcel side setback for an attached private garage is 0.6 m. Authored from source p.472.

notes: 1P2007 s.535(2)(c): the minimum separation distance between the main residential buildings on the front portion and the rear portion of the parcel is 6.5 m. Authored from source p.470 (R-CG deliverable rule missing from the first gold pass).

notes: 1P2007 s.535(3): the minimum building setback from the side property line shared with another parcel is 3.0 m for the building portion between the rear property line and 50% parcel depth (a building-depth provision stating a distinct side-setback minimum). Authored from source p.470.
